relay_rule: Messages are scheduled, never sent faster than light. Contents are destroyed on transmission; only weight, hold time and sender signature survive.

tariff.one_year_hold: one day of the strongest memory
tariff.consequence: The sender does not know what was taken. Only a hollow remains.

deferred_liability: A relay that cannot draw on a sender books the cost against the installation.
power: 61% of station electricity is waste heat from packet lattices
